narration:0:1460125001:1.text: Once the preliminary match schedule is agreed upon with Carolina and her companions, you depart the Duchy of Whiteridge, though not without the Graveborn's heartfelt insistence that you linger longer.
narration:0:1460125001:1.source_cn: 与卡列琳娜他们讨论并确定了初步的赛程方案后，你们才在亡...

narration:2:1460125002:0.text: No sooner do you step beneath the Lucent Tree than your eyes fall upon a familiar figure waiting in its glow...
narration:2:1460125002:0.source_cn: 刚刚抵达流荧树下，就看到那里熟悉的身影——

say:5:1460125003:1.text: It's been a long time, my friends.

say:6:1460125004:1.text: Eironn... it has been a long road since we last met. You have changed, my friend.
say:6:1460125004:1.source_cn: 埃隆，我亲爱的朋友，好久不见……你的变化真是太大了。

say:7:1460125005:1.text: When we first met, you were a freshly drawn blade... sharp, proud, and eager to cut.
say:7:1460125005:1.source_cn: 最初见面的时候，你就像是一柄经过磨砺的崭新利剑，锋芒毕露。

say:8:1460125006:1.text: Now, you stand like an ancient tree.
say:8:1460125006:1.source_cn: 但此时此刻，你站在面前，就像是……像是一棵树一样。

say:9:1460125007:1.source_cn: 温和，冷静，但又难以摧折。

say:10:1460125008:1.text: Your words honor me, but they are more than praise.
say:10:1460125008:1.source_cn: 过奖了，而且我知道，你并不只是在称赞我。

say:11:1460125009:1.text: If I'm not mistaken, the fire in your eyes says you've come seeking to test my strength.
say:11:1460125009:1.source_cn: 如果没猜错的话，你应该已经战意熊熊了，对不对？

say:12:1460125010:1.text: You are not wrong. If I hadn't gone through this journey, I would've challenged you without hesitation.
say:12:1460125010:1.source_cn: 是。如果没有经历这段时间的旅程，想必我会毫不犹豫地与你...

say:13:1460125011:0.text: But under <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s guidance, I glimpsed sights I had never known.
say:13:1460125011:0.male: But under <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s guidance, I glimpsed sights I had never known.
say:13:1460125011:0.female: But under <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s guidance, I glimpsed sights I had never known.

say:14:1460125012:0.text: I stand like a mountain of fire... not yet awakened, but ready, waiting for the chance to rise.
say:14:1460125012:0.source_cn: 此时的我，就像是即将喷发的火山一样——仍然缺少些许契机。

say:15:1460125013:1.text: Ah, yes, I understand this feeling well. In fact, I was in this state when I first met <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:15:1460125013:1.source_cn: 嗯……我明白，事实上，在最初见到<style=stre...
say:15:1460125013:1.male: Ah, yes, I understand this feeling well. In fact, I was in this state when I first met <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:15:1460125013:1.female: Ah, yes, I understand this feeling well. In fact, I was in this state when I first met <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:16:1460125014:1.text: It was under his guidance that I finally found my direction and became who I am today.
say:16:1460125014:1.male: It was under his guidance that I finally found my direction and became who I am today.
say:16:1460125014:1.female: It was under her guidance that I finally found my direction and became who I am today.

choice_prompt:17:1460125014.text: It was under his guidance that I finally found my direction and became who I am today.
choice_prompt:17:1460125014.source_cn: 是在<male>他</male><female>她</female>的引导下，我才终于找到了自己的方向，从而成为了现在的我。
choice_prompt:17:1460125014.male: It was under his guidance that I finally found my direction and became who I am today.
choice_prompt:17:1460125014.female: It was under her guidance that I finally found my direction and became who I am today.

say:18:1460125015:1.text: Yes, Bryon and Lyca told me a little about what is happening.
say:18:1460125015:1.source_cn: 嗯，我在等你们的时候，已经听布莱恩和莱卡他们讲过了。

say:19:1460125016:1.text: Be it for friendship or for rivalry, step forward and test your strength!
say:19:1460125016:1.source_cn: 无论是出于友谊还是好胜心，都来试试看吧！
